content.value: A 150 ×100 × 13 mm angle is to be welded to a gusset plate with the 150mm leg against the plate. If the angle carries a centroidal load of 400 kN, what lengths of 8 mm side fillet welds will be required along the toe and heel of the angle for a non-eccentric connection? Assume the allowable shearing stress through the throats of the welds is 145MPa.
8 A metal block is loaded as shown in the figure.
(i)Determine the normal stress and shearing stress in plane AB.
(ii) Determine the plane of maximum shearing stress and its value.
(iii) Show all results on complete sketches of differential elements.
